## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Kilocode #14485 git plugin install - HIGH PRIORITY (mcp + tool)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #14485 "feat(marketplace): install plugins from git repositories" merged 2026-09-23 implemented git-based plugin installation (install MCP plugins from git repos: public HTTPS, private SSH with key, local file:// URLs; parser extracts org/repo/commit/subpath from URL, rejects option-injection refs and malformed URLs, resolves symlinks before subpath containment checks, clones into cache dir with atomic swap, records resolved commit in identity, revalidates mutable refs (branches/tags) after TTL expiry, normalizes file:// URLs for Windows drive-less paths, namespaces git identities separately from npm/local). This is MCP plugin distribution (git-based install with security hardening, TTL-based revalidation, atomic clone swaps).

- **Why**: Alexi has MCP support (src/mcp/client.ts, mcp server registry via mcp-servers.json) but no automated plugin installation mechanism - MCP servers must be manually configured in mcp-servers.json with full command/args/env. Kilocode's git plugin install lets users install MCP servers from git URLs (public repos, private SSH repos with key, local file:// repos for dev), with security hardening (rejects option-injection refs like `--upload-pack`, containment checks prevent symlink escape, atomic clone swap prevents partial state) and staleness management (TTL-based revalidation for mutable refs). Useful for sharing/distributing MCP servers without manual JSON editing. Implementation path: add plugin install command (src/cli/commands/plugin-install.ts, takes git URL with optional #ref@subpath syntax), add git plugin resolver (src/mcp/git-resolver.ts, parses URL, validates ref, clones to cache dir ~/.alexi/plugin-cache/<identity>/, records resolved commit), add mcp-servers.json updater (insert installed plugin entry with resolved command/args from package.json or manifest), add TTL-based revalidation (check mutable refs against recorded commit after TTL expiry, re-clone if changed), write tests (public HTTPS, private SSH, local file://, mutable ref revalidation, option-injection rejection, containment checks).

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14485 (Kilocode git plugin install, merged 2026-09-23), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/mcp/client.ts (Alexi MCP client, no git install), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/commands/ (CLI commands, no plugin-install command)

- **Category**: mcp + tool (git-based plugin resolver + CLI install command)

- **Size**: LARGE (~12-16h). Add plugin install command (src/cli/commands/plugin-install.ts, Commander command `alexi plugin install <git-url>`, parses URL with optional `#ref@subpath`), add git plugin resolver (src/mcp/git-resolver.ts, validates URL, rejects option-injection refs `^--`, normalizes file:// URLs, clones to cache dir `~/.alexi/plugin-cache/<identity>/` with `git clone --depth 1 --branch <ref>`, resolves symlinks in subpath, checks containment, atomic swap via temp clone + rename, records resolved commit SHA), add mcp-servers.json updater (read package.json or .mcp-manifest.json from cloned repo, extract command/args, insert entry into mcp-servers.json with source metadata), add TTL-based revalidation (default 24h, check mutable refs via `git ls-remote`, re-clone if commit SHA changed), add SSH key support (pass GIT_SSH_COMMAND env for private repos), write tests (public HTTPS repo, private SSH repo, local file:// repo, mutable ref revalidation after TTL, option-injection rejection, symlink containment check, Windows drive-less file:// URL).

#### 2. Kilocode #14487 agent-manager status icons - MEDIUM PRIORITY (agent-manager + tool)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #14487 "fix(agent-manager): keep status icons current for other projects" merged 2026-09-23 fixed Agent Manager background project status staleness (Agent Manager previously filtered activity events by selected project directory, forwarding only idle/offline/deleted events for background projects; sessions in background projects kept stale offline status after reconnect, and completed/failed/waiting/scheduled states never reached sidebar; fix forwards all activity events for sessions the panel owns: status, deleted, wakeup, turn close, error, asked/replied for permissions/questions/suggestions; transcript events stay filtered; keeps owner entry when status goes offline since offline is not end-of-turn and session reconnects). This is multi-project status sync (Agent Manager forwards all owned session activity regardless of selected project).

- **Why**: Alexi has Agent Manager (src/tool/tools/agent-manager.ts, src/core/agent-manager/), which manages multi-worktree agent sessions. The Agent Manager may filter status updates too aggressively for background worktrees (sessions in non-selected worktrees show stale status until that worktree is selected). Kilocode's fix forwards activity events for *all owned sessions*, not just the selected project, so status icons stay current in the sidebar even when the session is in a background worktree. Implementation path: audit agent-manager activity event filtering (src/core/agent-manager/ or src/tool/tools/agent-manager.ts, check if status updates filtered by selected worktree), forward all owned session activity events (status, deleted, wakeup, turn close, error, permission/question/suggestion events), keep transcript events filtered (too expensive to sync for background sessions), write tests (background session status update reaches sidebar, selected session activity not affected).

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14487 (Kilocode agent-manager status fix, merged 2026-09-23), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/tool/tools/agent-manager.ts (Alexi Agent Manager tool), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/agent-manager/ (Agent Manager core)

- **Category**: agent-manager + tool (activity event filtering in Agent Manager)

- **Size**: SMALL (~2-3h). Audit agent-manager activity event filtering (src/core/agent-manager/ or src/tool/tools/agent-manager.ts, find directory/project filter in event handlers), forward all owned session activity events (status, deleted, wakeup, turn close, error, asked/replied events for permissions/questions/suggestions), keep transcript events filtered (too expensive for background sessions, filter by selected worktree), keep owner entry when status goes offline (offline is not end-of-turn, session may reconnect), write tests (background session status update visible, selected session not affected, transcript events stay filtered for background).

#### 4. Kilocode #14486 transcript virtualizer per-session - LOW PRIORITY (tui)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #14486 "fix(vscode): remount transcript virtualizer per session" merged 2026-09-23 fixed transcript rendering staleness (Virtua virtualizer keyed measured row sizes by list index, reusing one virtualizer across sessions applied stale sizes and scroll state from previous session; rows above last reply fell outside viewport and stayed unmounted, leaving blank space; fix gives each session its own keyed virtualizer, persists outgoing instance's sizes and position, syncs new instance to existing scroll offset). This is TUI session-switching rendering (per-session virtualizer avoids stale row sizes).

- **Why**: Alexi has Ink-based TUI (src/cli/tui/) with session switching (interactive REPL can switch between sessions via src/cli/interactive.ts). If Alexi uses a virtualizer (like react-window or virtua) for transcript rendering, it may reuse the same virtualizer instance across sessions, applying stale row sizes from the previous session (causing blank space or mis-aligned rows). Kilocode's fix creates a separate virtualizer instance per session. Low priority (Alexi TUI may not use a virtualizer, or may already avoid this issue; audit needed). Implementation path: audit transcript rendering (src/cli/tui/, check if virtualizer used, whether virtualizer reused across sessions), if virtualizer reused, key virtualizer by session ID (create new instance per session), persist/restore scroll position per session, write test (session switch does not apply stale row sizes, transcript renders correctly after switch).

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14486 (Kilocode virtualizer per-session fix, merged 2026-09-23), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/tui/ (Alexi TUI rendering)

- **Category**: tui (transcript rendering, virtualizer per-session)

- **Size**: SMALL (~2-3h). Audit transcript rendering (src/cli/tui/, check if virtualizer used for transcript, whether virtualizer instance keyed by session ID), if virtualizer reused across sessions, key virtualizer by session ID (create new instance per session, pass session ID as key), persist scroll position per session (store scroll offset in session metadata, restore on session switch), write test (session switch does not cause blank space, transcript renders correctly after switch).
